title: 3D Previz & Grayboxing Engine
subtitle: C++ WASM & WebGL Editor
description: Browser-based 3D grayboxing and pre-visualization tool featuring a modular C++ WASM math core, WebGL accelerated shadow mapping pipeline, and a Unity-style inspector interface.
architecture: Modular 3-tier architecture separating C++/Wasm linear-arena math core, engine.js WebGL abstraction pipeline, and scene_logic.js object inspector and keyframe management.
vision: Provide a lightweight, high-performance web tool for spatial blocking and camera animation planning with direct pipeline export to Blender.
